**MyDesk for Windows**

Download `MyDesk-Setup-x.y.z.exe` below and double-click it to install. It replaces the older version. If you already have 1.2.0, MyDesk offers this update by itself.

What's new in 1.2.1:
- **Stays signed in after a PC restart.** Your login is now saved to disk the moment it changes, so restarting or shutting down Windows no longer signs you out. (After updating, sign in once more if you were signed out.)

Still the same: it opens the live MyDesk site, so new features arrive without reinstalling. Press `Ctrl+R` to reload.

If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the installer isn't code-signed yet).
